chapter_meta_description: Sun Baolu reveals his horrifying secret: a childhood encounter in the cave left his body completely scrambled. Li Huowang must choose between his friend's warnings and his only cure for madness.

og_description: Sun Baolu’s anatomy is a living jigsaw puzzle of misplaced organs. Read the chapter where fear and friendship collide in the dark.

twitter_description: A childhood mistake turned a man into a walking anatomical nightmare. But his shame is nothing compared to Li Huowang’s determination to enter the source of the horror.

lore_anchors.definition: A wriggling black parasitic entity produced by twisted alchemy. Li Huowang believes it is his only cure for the crippling hallucinations that plague his mind.
A phosphorescent mineral used for illumination in the darkness of the Dao-Twisted World, adding a gritty, low-tech realism to the environment.
The term used by the group to describe Li Huowang’s dissociative and psychotic symptoms, including his violent cognitive breaks and hallucinatory episodes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to Sun Baolu in the cave?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a child, he was touched by an unseen entity that felt like a “large brush,” which physically rearranged his internal organs into a scrambled, disordered state.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang insist on entering the cave despite the danger?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He believes the Black Tai Sui, a parasitic entity inside the cave, is his only known cure for the hysteria and hallucinations that are driving him insane.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Sun Baolu finally agree to guide the group?
cultural_notes_faq.a: After failing to stop Li Huowang through persuasion, Sun Baolu overcomes his own traumatic fear to volunteer as a guide, driven by a sense of debt and loyalty to the man who saved his life.
